accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure Gold (#D4AF37) is only used on Black backgrounds for large text or graphical elements. Use White for body text.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable swipe animations if prefers-reduced-motion is true. Provide button alternatives (Like/Dislike buttons) below the card deck.

universal_guidelines: Use 'Manrope' for all body text and UI elements.
Always apply the noise texture to the body background.
Use the 'Void Black' theme. No light mode.
Swipe cards must have a 'throw' physics feel.
Form inputs should look like filling out a movie script (underlined, minimal).
Dashboard should look like a video editing timeline or bin.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install fonts: Syne and Manrope. Configure Tailwind colors as specified. Add noise texture SVG to globals.
instructions_to_main_agent.swipe_logic: Implement a deck stack. Top card is interactive. Swiping removes it and reveals the next. Preload images.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts for the Preference Scoring (Radar Chart or Bar Chart) styled with Gold/Red strokes.
